text:
The 537 ppm/C TC most likely comes from M1 losing headroom when it is cold. M1's drain voltage is n1 = Vgs7 − Veb1, only 0.187 V at 27 °C. At −40 °C Veb rises by about 0.13 V, so M1 drops below 4·U_T and the mirror ratio collapses. The sensitivities support this: lowering gmid_7 (which raises Vgs7) helps. Refining the parameters with steered bounds should give M1 that room back.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "TC is dominated by M1 losing Vds at the cold corner (n1=Vgs7-Veb1, only 0.19 V at 27C). Lower gmid_7 raises Vgs7 and M1 headroom (sensitivity confirms). Rebalance k_r2 and allow longer Ln to cut DIBL offset (amplified 10x by R2/R1). Keep M7 Vds above Vdsat.",
 "params": {"gmid_7": 5.0, "L7": 1.0, "k_r2": 10.5, "Ln": 2.0, "gmid_n": 24, "gmid_p": 16, "Lp": 2.0, "I": 2.0e-6},
 "bounds": {"gmid_7": [3.5, 9.0], "L7": [0.5, 4.0], "k_r2": [9.0, 12.5], "Ln": [1.0, 4.0], "gmid_p": [12, 20], "Lp": [1.0, 4.0]}}
```
